definitions.explanation: A refined or literary way to describe food or drink that tastes excellent.

examples.japanese: {美味|びみ}な{料理|りょうり}を{堪能|たんのう}した。
この{地方|ちほう}の{美味|びみ}を{楽|たの}しんでください。
examples.english: Please enjoy the fine flavors of this region.

examples.japanese: {旬|しゅん}の{食材|しょくざい}を{使|つか}った{美味|びみ}な{一品|いっぴん}を{提供|ていきょう}しています。
examples.english: We serve exquisite dishes using seasonal ingredients.

notes:
A literary and refined way to say delicious. Used more in writing, menus, and food descriptions than in everyday conversation. Can function as a noun (meaning delicious food/a delicacy) or as a na-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美味|びみ}な{料理|りょうり} — delicious cuisine
- {美味|びみ}を{堪能|たんのう}する — to savor a delicacy
- {美味|びみ}を{味|あじ}わう — to savor fine food
- {珍味|ちんみ}{美味|びみ} — rare delicacies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おいしい — delicious (everyday, most common)
- {美味|おい}しい — delicious (same kanji, colloquial reading)
- {絶品|ぜっぴん} — superb dish, masterpiece (stronger praise)
- {旨|うま}い — delicious, tasty (informal)

REGISTER:
More formal and literary than おいしい. Often seen in restaurant descriptions, food writing, travel brochures, and formal dining contexts.
